sections.description:
EasyCommerce is the all-in-one ecommerce WordPress plugin designed to help you create, manage, and grow your online store with unmatched ease. With its user-friendly interface and intuitive features, you can focus on what truly matters: selling your products and connecting with customers.

EasyCommerce is made to be fully responsive, whether you’re just starting out or you want to streamline your existing online store to sell products effortlessly. Enjoy real-time business insights, seamless product management, secure payments, and smooth checkout experiences—all in one simple solution.

Make online selling effortless — try EasyCommerce today!

Want to learn more about the EasyCommerce ecommerce plugin?

✅ Features
✅ Addons
✅ Documentation
✅ Support

🚀 Why Choose EasyCommerce?

⭐ Real-Time Insights – Track sales, orders, and abandoned carts, all from the dashboard.
⭐ Streamlined Product Management – Easily manage your catalog, stock levels, and variations.
⭐ Abandoned Cart Recovery – Track abandoned shopping carts and send reminders, directly from the dashboard.
⭐ Secure Payment Gateways – Offer payments via popular methods like PayPal, Stripe, and more.
⭐ Digital Downloads – Sell digital downloads like PDFs, Ebooks, and more.
⭐ Automated Shipping Calculations – Provide accurate shipping costs based on location, weight, and more at checkout.
⭐ Customizable Product Pages – Customize product pages to reflect your unique brand and style.
⭐ Coupon & Discount Management – Create and activate custom coupons to encourage more sales.
⭐ Email Personalization – Send custom emails based on customer activity to boost engagement.
⭐ Easy Integrations – Access a library of integrations to add advanced functionality to your online store.
⭐ Custom Taxation – Set custom tax classes based on different locations, and display them clearly at checkout.

📊 EasyCommerce Dashboard: Your Store at a Glance

The EasyCommerce dashboard is the core of your ecommerce store, giving you a clear view of what’s happening in real-time. It’s designed to keep everything in one place so you can easily sell online on your WordPress store, and monitor how your business is doing.

Want to know more about your sales number or if a product is trending? Just take a look at your dashboard—it’s all there!

🔥 Real-Time Sales Data – Keep an eye on your daily, weekly, or monthly sales with live updates.
🔥 Order Tracking – Stay on top of all your latest orders—whether they’re in progress, completed, or on hold.
🔥 Trending Products – See which items are getting attention, so you can confidently plan your next moves.
🔥 Low Stock Products – Easily track product variations that are running low and ensure your inventory is always stocked.

With everything at your fingertips, the EasyCommerce dashboard helps you sell products, quickly make decisions, and keep your business running smoothly.

📦 Simple, Stress-Free Product Control

With the EasyCommerce online shop plugin, you can add new items, update existing ones, and keep your online store running smoothly, without breaking a sweat.

Each feature is designed to help you sell online on your WordPress store, so you can focus more on your sales and less on the details.

Plus, you will have full control over your inventory and how everything is displayed on your ecommerce website.

🔥 Add and Edit Products – Make quick updates or add new products without hassle.
🔥 Customizable Product Pages – Customize each product’s page with templates to match your brand’s style and voice.
🔥 Variation Pricing – Set individual prices and SKUs for each variation of a product, with just a few clicks.
🔥 Inventory Control – Easily manage stock levels and product variations to avoid over sell products.

With EasyCommerce, product management is fast, organized, and flexible—so you can grow your business on your WordPress ecommerce site.

📋 Streamlined Order Management

With EasyCommerce online shop plugin, you can easily track, process, sell products, and fulfill orders all from one place—helping your customers get what they need, faster. No more juggling between different tools or systems on your ecommerce WordPress plugin.

With everything in one spot, you can stay on top of each order and make sure everything runs smoothly on your WordPress ecommerce store.

🔥 Track Orders in One Place – View all incoming, in-progress, and completed orders without confusion.
🔥 Order Statuses – Let customers know the status of their order with customized email updates.
🔥 Order Fulfilment – Update your order fulfillment statuses each step of the way to keep your workflow running smoothly.

EasyCommerce keeps everything organized on your ecommerce WordPress site, so you can sell online, reduce mistakes, and make the entire process smoother for both you and your customers.

🔄 Bring Back Lost Sales

Not everyone completes their purchase on the first go, but with the EasyCommerce best ecommerce plugin, you can easily reconnect with those potential buyers.

The abandoned shopping cart recovery feature helps you track and sell products to shoppers who left without purchasing from your ecommerce website. With just a few clicks, you can remind them of what they left behind, giving you another shot at closing the sale.

🔥 Track Abandoned Carts – See exactly which customers have left items in their shopping cart without checking out.
🔥 Reminder Emails – Send follow-up emails directly from the dashboard to bring customers back.
🔥 Recover Lost Revenue – Convert abandoned shopping carts into completed purchases and increase sales.

EasyCommerce online shop plugin helps you sell online on your ecommerce WordPress store and stay on top of revenue that might otherwise slip away.

💳 Simple & Secure Payments

The EasyCommerce ecommerce plugin lets your customers complete their purchases with a variety of trusted payment methods. From PayPal to Square, Stripe to Paddle, you can accept payments securely and provide a smooth checkout experience on your ecommerce website.

With built-in security features, your customers can shop with peace of mind, knowing their transactions are safe on your WordPress ecommerce store.

🔥 Major Payment Gateways – Accept payments through trusted services like PayPal, Stripe, and more on your ecommerce website.
🔥 Secure Transactions – Rest easy knowing every payment is processed with built-in security.
🔥 No Hidden Fees – With EasyCommerce, you won’t pay any platform fees per order—only standard gateway charges apply.

🏷️ Drive Sales with Custom Coupons

Create and manage promotions in just a few clicks to encourage sales and engage with customers. Enter all the necessary values, a usability timeframe, and a price range, and instantly make the offer live on your WordPress ecommerce website.

You can also manage your entire list of coupons from a single page. Use these discounts to reward your customers while creating buzz about your products.

🔥 Create Custom Coupons – Easily design discount codes for specific products from one simple interface.
🔥 Flexible Discount Options – You can decide on the percentage or fixed value for each coupon.
🔥 Set Conditions & Expiry Dates – Define rules for each coupon, like minimum product value or expiration dates, so you can control how and when they’re used.

EasyCommerce ensures that you have full control over the whole discount process, so you can run campaigns that meet your business objectives.

🔗 Expand Your Store’s Potential with Integrations

Get access to a wide range of integrations to add advanced functionality to your WordPress ecommerce store, without the complexity.

EasyCommerce online shop plugin has a library of add-ons that you can add or purchase to sell online, streamline your operations, and expand your ecommerce WordPress store’s functionalities.

🔥 Add New Features – Connect to services that provide advanced functionalities, such as collecting leads, store migration, or notification channels.
🔥 Seamless Integration Process – Adding new tools to your ecommerce store is straightforward, with easy-to-follow steps for each integration.
🔥 Automate Marketing Efforts – Integrate with popular CRM tools and notification channels to make your marketing tasks effortless.

EasyCommerce is the best ecommerce plugin to add new tools, which gives you more time to focus on growing your online store.

💪 What Sets EasyCommerce Apart?

EasyCommerce simplifies selling online without sacrificing the features that matter most. Unlike other best ecommerce plugins that require extensive setup or multiple add-ons just to get started, EasyCommerce provides built-in tools for managing products, orders, payments, promotions, and customer engagement—all in one place.

While additional plugins may be required for specific features, EasyCommerce offers a growing list of integrations to help you add the tools you need without unnecessary complications.

✔️ Payment Gateways – Accept payments through trusted services like Mollie, Square, Stripe, PayPal, and Braintree to provide your customers with secure payment options.

✔️ WooCommerce Migration – Transitioning from WooCommerce is straightforward, so you can quickly import your existing products, orders, and customer data.

✔️ Slack Integration – Stay updated with real-time notifications about your ecommerce store’s activities directly in your Slack channels and keep your team informed always.

✔️ HubSpot Integration – Improve your marketing efforts by syncing customer data with HubSpot to enable targeted campaigns and connect with customers better.

Check out the full list of integrations: EasyCommerce Addons

sections.installation:
Install EasyCommerce in just a few simple steps by following the steps mentioned below.

Step 1: Find the EasyCommerce plugin

Go to your WordPress dashboard and navigate to Plugins > Add New Plugin. Look for EasyCommerce in the search bar from the top right.

Step 2: Install and Activate

Once you’ve found the EasyCommerce plugin, click the Install Now button, and Activate.

Step 3: Setup Wizard

Next, go to Plugin > Installed Plugins, and click Setup Wizard under EasyCommerce (you can find this from the top bar as well) to start setting up your shop.

Enter all the necessary details under each step, including your name and email in the last step. You will receive an email with an API token, which you can use to complete your integration with EasyCommerce.

Step 4: Enter API Key

To apply your API key, click the Go to Store button and find the account icon from the top right corner.

Click the “Yes, I have an API key” button, enter your email and the token you’ve already received, and hit the “Verify” button to instantly connect with EasyCommerce.
sections.faq:
Why do I need an API key?

The EasyCommerce API key will help you connect your store to our system, so you can easily integrate with our add-ons and other services seamlessly.

Can I sell digital downloads using EasyCommerce?

Yes. EasyCommerce lets you sell PDF, ZIP files, ePub, JPEGs, and other digital files. You can add these products to your inventory from the same section as physical products.

Can I use EasyCommerce with any WordPress theme?

Yes, EasyCommerce works with most WordPress themes. However, for the best experience, it is recommended to use a theme optimized for ecommerce.

Is EasyCommerce free to use?

EasyCommerce is free to install and use, but additional charges may apply for certain add-ons and hosting services.

Which payment gateways can I use?

Currently, EasyCommerce provides payment gateway add-ons for PayPal, Stripe, Square, Mollie, and Braintree.

Does EasyCommerce take transaction fees for payment gateways?

With EasyCommerce, you won’t pay any platform fees per order—only standard gateway charges apply.

Will EasyCommerce slow down my site?

EasyCommerce is designed to be lightweight and optimized for performance, so it should not slow down your site. However, performance may vary depending on your hosting environment.

What are the system requirements for EasyCommerce?

WordPress version: 6.0
Required PHP Version: 7.4

Where can I get support for EasyCommerce?

EasyCommerce provides community support via the EasyCommerce Facebook Group. You can also avail of dedicated support by raising a ticket here.
